caption: The drawing depicts a long, full-sleeved coat or dress made of a deep blue fabric. The coat features a wide, rounded collar and a belt at the waist, both in a contrasting mauve-purple color, with mauve trim along the edges of the collar, belt, cuffs, and the front opening. The coat extends to the ankles and has a front closure with three buttons visible from the chest to the lower part. The inside lining of the coat is a lighter shade of blue, visible at the bottom front opening. To the upper right of the main illustration, there is a smaller, lightly sketched rear view of the same garment, which shows the length, long sleeves, and the back view of the collar and belt detail. The background is plain and light beige, with no other objects or decorations present.
title: Coat
